title: Threatens Tariffs on Allies Over Greenland Bid

description_long: Trump’s reported threat linked trade measures to his effort to acquire Greenland. He said imports from Denmark, Norway and Germany could face tariffs unless those governments dropped their objections. The episode moved a territorial dispute into the realm of economic pressure on allied countries, raising the prospect that trade policy would be used to advance a separate diplomatic demand. A tariff threat can create uncertainty for exporters and importers even before a measure is applied, although no specific commercial disruption is documented here. The record therefore describes a threatened measure and its stated condition, rather than an enacted tariff policy or a demonstrated outcome.

title: AP Data Contradicts Trump's Claim That He Kept Nearly All Promises
description_short: AP Data Contradicts Trump's Claim That He Kept Nearly All Promises
description_medium: The Associated Press’s public promise tracker offered a way to compare Trump’s claim that he kept nearly all his promises with the status of individual commitments. description_long: The Associated Press’s promise tracker organized Trump’s public commitments by policy area and showed their status over time. That record offered a measurable comparison with his claim that he had kept nearly all his promises: readers could examine individual commitments rather than rely on a broad summary of his record. A tracker can distinguish promises reported as completed from those still in progress or otherwise unresolved, and it gives journalists and the public a common set of entries to discuss. The packet does not identify when Trump made the specific claim, how many promises AP counted, or which entries contradicted it. The size of the discrepancy therefore cannot be established here, and the tracker alone does not show how the comparison affected public opinion or policy.
